summary.text: Paul Wojno is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate representing District 10, and his caucus biography says he is serving his second term.
He previously served in the Michigan House of Representatives from 1997 to 2002.

paragraphs.text: Born in Detroit, Wojno is a lifelong Michigan resident and a graduate of Center Line High School.
He attended Macomb Community College and the University of Michigan and earned his bachelor's degree from Wayne State University.
His caucus biography lists him as chairman of the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules and Majority Vice Chair of the Elections and Local Government committees.
It says he has worked on legislation on senior citizens, education, human trafficking, substance abuse and voter protection.
He and his wife, Lisa, live in Warren and raised three children.
